source.title: Flux tubes, surface magnetism, and the solar dynamo: constraints and open problems

trace.notes: Normalized the input as one zbMATH resolver URL with trailing identifier 2167495.

Local shard metadata identified the exact work as 'Flux tubes, surface magnetism, and the solar dynamo: constraints and open problems' with DOI 10.1002/asna.200410376 and year 2005. This metadata was used only for identity and title recovery, not for extraction.

The available page reader did not expose a readable zbMATH record body for https://zbmath.org/2167495, and a local shell fetch of the zbMATH API host failed with DNS resolution failure in the sandbox.

Bounded exact-work recovery tried the DOI, expected Wiley landing and PDF endpoints, exact-title searches, exact-DOI searches, and MPS publication pages. The MPS page contained only a bibliographic citation, while other recovered pages were metadata, citations, related works, or citing works rather than a readable full-text PDF or HTML source for the same article.

Failure mode metadata_only: no readable exact-work primary source was recovered, so the source adequacy gate blocks extraction from resolver metadata, title text, citation-only pages, search snippets, or related papers.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/2167495.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
